{{TAGDEF|VDW_A1|[real]}}

Description: {{TAG|VDW_A1}} sets the scaling <math>a_{1}</math> of the critical radii in the rational Becke-Johnson damping function of the DFT-D3 and [[DFT-D4]] methods.
----
{{TAG|VDW_A1}} allows to set the scaling <math>a_{1}</math> of the critical radii in the rational Becke-Johnson damping function:
*[[DFT-D3]] ({{TAG|IVDW}}=12).
*[[simple-DFT-D3]] ({{TAG|IVDW}}=15 with {{TAG|SDFTD3_DAMPING}}=rational, mrational, or optimizedpower).
*[[DFT-D4]] ({{TAG|IVDW}}=13).
